== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
{{Migrating Ancestor | origin = Ireland | destination = United States | origin-flag = Flags-1.gif | destination-flag = US_Flags-1.png}}
{{Pennsylvania Sticker}}
Nelson was born about 1 May 1848. 
<ref>Stated on his US  death certificate -- although these are more often wrong than right for Irish immigrants from this time.</ref>
He was the son of [[Glasgow-1699|John Glasgow]] and [[Ferguson-16492|Ann Jane Ferguson]].  
<ref>He is named in his father's will as being in Philadelphia; and his death certificate names his parents.</ref>

On 11 Jun 1895 in Camden, New Jersey, USA, he married Mary E Linton.
<ref>"New Jersey Marriages, 1678-1985", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FZR6-29S : 27 August 2020), Nelson Glasgow, 1895.</ref>
She was born in Ireland and age 37 as of 1910. They had children John, Thomas James, Robert, and William Alexander. 

He passed away 12 May 1921 at Philadelphia due to spinal sclerosis of 5 years.  He had been an employee of P R J Co.  Witnessed by Thomas J Glasgow of same address, 1512 Melon St. He was buried at Cedar Hill.
<ref>{{Ancestry Record|PADeathCollection|1561564}} Nelson Glasgow, 1921.  Pennsylvania Historic and Museum Commission; Harrisburg, PA; Pennsylvania (State). Death Certificates, 1906-1968; Certificate Number Range: 050501-053500. Source Information: Ancestry.com. Pennsylvania, U.S., Death Certificates, 1906-1967 [database on-line]. Provo, UT, USA: Ancestry.com Operations, Inc., 2014.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1699]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Residence and uncommon name join the Irish father to this adult son.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.
